pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Open the file is a command.
We say “You open the file” for a command.
How many asks about a number.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Open the file is a command. → Verdadeiro (Yes, it is an imperative.)
We say “You open the file” for a command. → Falso (We use Open the file.)
How many asks about a number. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A big office · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Monday morning in a big office in Chicago. People type on their computers. Mona sits near the printer. Her friend Ben comes in with his phone. He has a train ticket on the screen. Mona looks up and smiles.
“Hi, Ben! Do you need help?” says Mona. “Yes, I want to print my train ticket. How many pages are there?” says Ben. “There is one page. Open the file first.” says Mona.
